vulnerabilities.title: Non-Atomic Multi-Transaction Order Settlement and Missing Concurrent Row Locking
vulnerabilities.remediation_note: Refactored BUY and SELL settlement into atomic commit_order_settlement inside session.begin() with Postgres with_for_update row locking; verified by fault-injection rollback test.

vulnerabilities.title: Missing Authentication, Authorization, and Rate Limiting on FastAPI Control, Settings, and WebSocket Endpoints
vulnerabilities.remediation_note: Implemented require_admin_auth dependency (Bearer / X-Nexus-API-Key), WebSocket token authentication, sliding-window IP rate limiter, and 2MB payload size limit middleware.

vulnerabilities.title: Unwired Runtime Trading Orchestrator and Volatile In-Memory Signal Deduplication
vulnerabilities.remediation_note: Implemented AutonomousPaperTradingOrchestrator directly wiring MarketDataService, NexusStrategyV1, and PersistentPaperBroker with kill-switch abort and checkpoint persistence export/import.

vulnerabilities.title: Unscrubbed Exception Strings in Logs and Raw Database Health Error Reflection
vulnerabilities.remediation_note: Added regex value scrubbing for DSN passwords, Bearer tokens, and API keys in structlog processor; sanitized check_health error reflection.

vulnerabilities.title: Synchronous Event-Loop Blocking in Backtest Endpoint and Nullable Idempotency Key on Direct Broker Calls
vulnerabilities.remediation_note: Offloaded run_suite via asyncio.to_thread, enforced non-null automatic client_order_id assignment, and handled MarketDataUnavailableError cleanly in broker.

vulnerabilities.title: Root Container Execution, Missing Nginx Security Headers, and Unencrypted Port Exposure
vulnerabilities.remediation_note: Added non-root user in Dockerfile, npm ci build, strict Nginx CSP/clickjacking/MIME security headers with server_tokens off, and locked docker-compose ports to 127.0.0.1 loopback with cap_drop ALL.

vulnerabilities.title: Missing Exchange Timestamp Masking in Ticker Parser and Entry-Cost Fallback in MTM
vulnerabilities.remediation_note: Rejected unverified/missing ticker timestamps with MarketDataUnavailableError and added open position quote verification halting new entries if quotes are unavailable.

vulnerabilities.title: Wildcard CORS Allow-Headers and Static Default Backtest FX Rate
vulnerabilities.remediation_note: Restricted CORS allow_headers to explicit safe headers and wired dynamic FX rate fetching into terminal backtest execution.

vulnerabilities.title: Open Python Dependency Ranges, Absent Git VCS, and Missing Lockfiles
vulnerabilities.remediation_note: Initialized Git repository with gitignored .env, generated requirements.lock for deterministic Python dependency pinning, and switched frontend Dockerfile to npm ci.

vulnerabilities.title: Absence of Live PostgreSQL Execution Verification
vulnerabilities.remediation_note: Applied Alembic migrations to live Aiven PostgreSQL, verified table schema and health probe, and added automated live PostgreSQL test in security test suite.
